output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-bef144404e5c] is only a metric name. The section it belongs to, [ev-1f419676f177], states the change. Metrics in this list that start with `cortex_` will start with `loki_` in this release, so this one becomes `loki_prometheus_last_evaluation_samples`. Only environments that leave `metrics_namespace` at its default of `loki` are exposed, because setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name. The consequence for an exposed environment that does nothing is that the metric is no longer emitted under its `cortex_` name. Because `metrics_namespace` is deprecated and due to be removed in the next minor release, the `cortex` workaround is only temporary.
